races.paceDynamic: Phoenix Arizona will lead from the gate with no other confirmed front runners to pressure him early, creating a sustainable gallop through the first circuit. Raydamann, Hasten Slowly, Jaariam and Bocelli's Voice will all want prominent positions behind the leader, creating serious congestion and traffic issues approaching the business end. The hold-up horses Torquay Road, Woodstream Lad, Rich Belief and Tomas O Maille will rely on gaps appearing in the straight. This uncontested lead followed by late crowding strongly favours the patient hold-up performers who can avoid the mid-race scramble and find clear runs when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prosper
scenarios.trigger: If Phoenix Arizona sets a steady tempo and the prominent brigade get in each other's way approaching 2 out
scenarios.body: The patient types get first run on the leaders while the prominent runners are still trying to extricate themselves from trouble. Clear sailing in the final furlong allows class to tell.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Position Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If Raydamann or Hasten Slowly can secure an ideal stalking position without getting caught in traffic
scenarios.body: They get first run on the uncontested leader and have enough in reserve to hold off the late challengers. The best of both worlds - no early pressure but close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Phoenix Arizona Survives
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite's lack of early pressure allows him to build an unassailable lead
scenarios.body: His modest ability is masked by getting such an easy lead that the field can never quite reel him in. Sometimes in weak races, tactics beat talent.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Creates Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion causes fallers or major interference approaching the second-last hurdle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with form horses struggling to get competitive runs while outsiders benefit from staying out of trouble. Late reshuffling produces surprise results.

watchPoints.text: Watch for multiple fallers or interference at the second-last hurdle where Raydamann, Hasten Slowly, Jaariam and Bocelli's Voice converge
Phoenix Arizona could steal this if his early advantage becomes unassailable in a weak race
Torquay Road and Woodstream Lad both hold-up types who need the pace to develop - watch for late moves
Eyeeye's 256-day absence makes any market confidence extremely suspicious
Rich Belief switching back to hurdles after recent flat racing could catch others napping if the pace sets up right

races.paceDynamic: Bangor Lady is the only confirmed front runner in this field and will likely dictate terms from the front without significant early pressure. The majority of runners are hold-up types (Scathach, Family Getaway, Tawny Lea, Clash Gold, Ellens Pride, Carrigeen Kirkia, Cherry Red, Mo Chailin Mor) with only Crios Cu Chulainn's style uncertain, creating a scenario where the pace-setter can control the gallop. With such a preponderance of hold-up horses and minimal early pace pressure, this race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure good early positions without expending energy in contested battles.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Bangor Lady gets an easy lead and the hold-up horses fail to mount a strong enough challenge
scenarios.body: The front runner controls the tempo completely and has enough left to resist the late closers who face too much to do. This tactical advantage outweighs her moderate recent form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Quality Prevails Late
scenarios.trigger: If the better-rated horses Scathach and Clash Gold can overcome the tactical disadvantage with superior ability
scenarios.body: Despite giving the leader a head start, class tells in the final furlong as the pace becomes unsustainable for Bangor Lady. The hold-up horses time their runs perfectly to sweep past.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lesser lights like Carrigeen Kirkia or Ellens Pride finds significant improvement
scenarios.body: A horse with an unfancied profile benefits from the slow early pace and weak opposition to spring a surprise. The tactical setup allows a moderate performer to compete above their usual level.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Bangor Lady fails to maintain her lead and the entire field comes to a crawl
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the final flight with no horse able to establish dominance, leading to a blanket finish. Any horse getting a clear run can capitalize on the tactical chaos.

watchPoints.text: Bangor Lady's jumping under pressure - if she makes errors when challenged her front-running advantage disappears completely
Family Getaway's fitness after 146 days off - Elliott runners often need time but she could be primed for improvement
Scathach's early positioning - if she gets closer than usual to the pace it suggests connections expect her to fade less
The pace through the first mile - if Bangor Lady goes too fast early the hold-up horses will have a major advantage
Crios Cu Chulainn's tactics - her running style remains unclear and could significantly impact how the race unfolds

races.paceDynamic: The Boysofairhill, Crystabel, and Let's Go La Fichad will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three confirmed front-runners likely to go forward early. The Boysofairhill showed keen tendencies at Listowel while Let's Go La Fichad has been noted as headstrong in previous starts, suggesting they'll set a searching pace over this stamina-testing 2m1½f trip. With 16 runners and three dedicated pace-setters, the tempo will be honest throughout, potentially exposing any lack of fitness or stamina in the field. This sustained gallop strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with proven stamina reserves who can pick up the pieces when the early leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too fast early and fade from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will set up perfectly for closers like Commodity Broker and Mc Swagger who can stay on when others tire. Lilac Lady's local course form and hold-up style also suits this collapse scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mullins Quality Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Koliath De Couely shows the ability that warranted his €150,000 purchase price
scenarios.body: Willie Mullins' French recruit was beaten just a short head on his only start and represents significant untapped potential in a weak maiden. The strong pace will help him settle and finish strongly despite the 366-day layoff.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Proven Form Holds Up
scenarios.trigger: If the exposed horses with recent course experience can capitalize on their fitness advantage
scenarios.body: Hopeful Hero's consistent placed form in bumpers and hurdles gives him a clear edge over newcomers and point graduates. Killowen House's recent third and stable connection to Chantry House adds further substance to the proven form angle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can dictate terms and maintain their advantage to the line
scenarios.body: Crystabel has shown improved form with two recent thirds and could find the tactical speed to control the race from the front. The mare's 7lb allowance and recent course experience provide additional advantages in a weak contest.

watchPoints.text: The Boysofairhill and Let's Go La Fichad could set suicidal fractions if both race keenly from the start
Koliath De Couely represents unknown Mullins quality but the 366-day absence creates significant fitness doubts
Hopeful Hero needs to prove the 212-day break hasn't blunted his edge despite previous consistent form
Crystabel's front-running style could be compromised if forced into a speed battle with two other confirmed leaders
Commodity Broker showed enough promise when hampered on debut to warrant serious consideration at likely odds

races.paceDynamic: Gforcejenny looks the most likely early leader with her prominent style and lack of other confirmed pace horses in this 19-runner field. Hurricane Honey, Saint Peregrine, and Annarubyrose may press forward early but none are aggressive pace-setters. The moderate early gallop will allow the large contingent of hold-up horses to stay in touch through the early stages. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favors prominent runners who can travel well in the first half of the field and kick when the race develops, rather than the many hold-up horses who will need a stronger gallop to maximize their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Benefits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If Gforcejenny sets a steady tempo with Hurricane Honey and Annarubyrose tracking
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows prominent runners to save energy for a strong finish while hold-up horses get caught behind traffic in the large field. Those positioned handy throughout can strike decisively when the race opens up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Gforcejenny goes too slow early and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: The crawling pace turns into a sprint finish where the freshest finishers from the back can unleash devastating late runs. Hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks benefit from the tactical nature.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improved Timurshah Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the Clonmel winner has turned the corner permanently after his impressive recent win
scenarios.body: His victory margin suggests significant improvement and the good ground suits his winning conditions perfectly. The five-day turnaround might not be an issue given his dominant last performance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners engage early and create genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: Hurricane Honey or Annarubyrose challenge Gforcejenny early creating a strong gallop that sets up the race for closers. The hold-up brigade gets the pace injection they need for maximum effectiveness.

watchPoints.text: Timurshah running just four days after his Clonmel breakthrough could be vulnerable to the quick turnaround despite his impressive winning margin

Multiple horses carry fading tendencies late so watch for those who travel strongly through the race rather than in the market

races.paceDynamic: Joshua's Daylami is the only confirmed front runner in this 17-runner field, giving him control to dictate a sustainable gallop over this demanding 3m2f trip. With most of the field holding up or running prominently, the early pace will be moderate, allowing Joshua's Daylami to build a comfortable lead before the business end. This tactical setup strongly favors hold-up horses who can finish from off the pace, as they'll get the perfect launching pad from a steady tempo that will inevitably quicken late. The prominent runners may struggle to sustain their effort if they chase too hard, making this a race for horses with a strong finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Joshua's Daylami sets a moderate pace and the field remains compact turning for home
scenarios.body: The sustainable gallop will perfectly suit the patient hold-up brigade who can unleash their finish over the final half-mile. Horses like Attaboyarchie, Aine's Lad and Spellacy's Cross have the tactical speed to pick off weakening leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely slow and the prominent horses can conserve energy
scenarios.body: Private Policy and The Dabbler could use their tactical positions to steal a march on the hold-up horses when the tempo lifts. Their ability to travel strongly in behind the leader gives them first run on the field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Joshua's Daylami Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and no serious challenge materializes until very late
scenarios.body: The front runner could build such a commanding lead that his stamina reserves prove decisive over this extreme distance. His controlled tempo would leave enough in the tank to resist late challengers on ground that may not suit him ideally.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Joshua's Daylami fades dramatically and the prominent horses also empty out in the straight
scenarios.body: The race would become a sprint finish between the freshest hold-up horses, with those coming from furthest back having the greatest advantage. This would particularly suit any hold-up horse with a high cruising speed who stayed widest of all.

races.paceDynamic: Tradonthebay is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, with Steps In The Sand, Johnny M, Max Time and Joe's Turn likely to race prominently behind him. With such a large field of 19 runners and most having hold-up styles, this creates a tactical race where the early pace will be moderate rather than fierce. The lack of pace pressure on Tradonthebay means he can control the tempo and kick clear when ready. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably develop in the large pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Tradonthebay gets an uncontested lead and maintains his recent good form on this ground.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows him to dictate ideal fractions and prove hard to peg back up the hill. His recent course and distance second gives him a significant tactical and track advantage over this large field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace allows a classy hold-up horse to produce a sweeping finish through traffic.
scenarios.body: Joya Del Mar or Clone Cross time their challenges perfectly as the front runners tire on the climb to the line. The winner benefits from racing fresh behind the steady gallop and having the class to accelerate when needed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Steps In The Sand gets a perfect stalking position and avoids his usual finishing fade.
scenarios.body: Racing just behind Tradonthebay gives him first run on the field while avoiding the traffic problems further back. His course and distance win earlier this year proves he can handle these exact conditions when fresh.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Tradonthebay goes too slow early and gets swamped by the large field in a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge from the back as multiple hold-up horses get hampered and interfere with each other. An unconsidered outsider who gets a clean run benefits from the mayhem.
